title: Roger Leir's implant extractions

tellings.quote: my colleague and good friend Ellie Marculli worked with Lair and and was there when they extracted some of these implants

plain: Roger Leir, a surgeon, is said to have removed small objects from people's bodies that were believed to be implants, things put there by non-human beings. The researcher Tim Alberino tells it second-hand: he says his colleague and friend Ellie Marculli worked with Leir and was in the room when some of these implants were taken out.
